name: hop-top-kit-ts
description: Build CLIs and services in TypeScript or JavaScript with the kit SDK `@hop-top/kit`: createCLI, output formats, layered config, MCP serving, safety guards, LLM adapters. Use when code imports `@hop-top/kit`, when adding kit to a Node project, or when a task needs a kit capability in TypeScript and you must check this port covers it. Not for choosing a language: the router skill does that.
